name: Phantom Stories
source:
This project is a collection of short stories - visual novels. Most of them are made in 2D digital comic book format. Some are made as a full 3D game and includes elements of interactivity.

[From [url=https://phantomaster.itch.io/phantomstories]Itch.io[/url]]
